purpose: add distribution-free split-conformal uncertainty to continuous and circular ODSP state predictions without assuming Gaussian or von Mises calibration is correct

continuous_target.prediction_object: interval around an upstream predicted center
continuous_target.nonconformity: abs(y - center) / scale when a positive predicted scale is supplied, otherwise abs(y-center)
continuous_target.guarantee: finite-sample marginal coverage under exchangeability of calibration and target rows

circular_target.prediction_object: circular arc around an upstream predicted circular center
circular_target.nonconformity: shortest circular distance between observed and predicted state
circular_target.guarantee: finite-sample marginal coverage under exchangeability of calibration and target rows

joint_bonferroni_target.allocation: equal Bonferroni split: alpha/2 to each component
joint_bonferroni_target.interpretation: simultaneous marginal-coverage construction, not a fitted joint density confidence region

finite_sample_quantile_rule: ceil((n_cal+1)*(1-alpha))-th ordered calibration score, clipped to the largest calibration score

obligations: mean exchangeable continuous coverage lies between 0.885 and 0.915
mean exchangeable circular coverage lies between 0.885 and 0.915
mean exchangeable Bonferroni joint coverage lies between 0.89 and 0.93
deliberately shifted continuous coverage is below 0.60
deliberately shifted circular coverage is below 0.60
continuous standardized conformal quantile is invariant to positive affine response-unit change to absolute error <= 1e-10
circular conformal arc is invariant to common phase-origin shift to absolute error <= 1e-10
circular conformal half-width rescales exactly under hours-to-minutes period-unit conversion to relative absolute error <= 1e-10
